title: Eliminate production CLI imports from @eshyra/core/internal
description:
Eliminate production CLI imports from @eshyra/core/internal.

Problem:
Project guidance says production callers should depend only on @eshyra/core's stable root export, while @eshyra/core/internal is unstable. Production CLI code currently imports from @eshyra/core/internal, which weakens the package boundary and risks making internal APIs de facto public.

Acceptance criteria:
- Audit production files under packages/cli/src for imports from @eshyra/core/internal.
- Promote CLI-needed APIs/types to the stable @eshyra/core root export, or create a deliberate supported subpath such as @eshyra/core/cli if that is the chosen design.
- Keep test/evaluation-only internal imports allowed where appropriate.
- Add a boundary test or static guard that fails if packages/cli/src/**/*.ts imports @eshyra/core/internal.
- Do not weaken AGENTS.md or public/internal documentation to make the violation disappear.
close_reason: Promoted CLI-needed APIs to @eshyra/core root export, repointed all 13 production CLI files off /internal, added packages/cli/test/internalBoundary.test.ts static guard. PR #319.
